summary: Verified the reported sidebar-navigation bug is fixed. Admin login works, all 9 sidebar destinations (Overview, Transactions, Investments, Subscriptions, Budgets, Analytics, Security center, Profile, Settings) navigate back-to-back without any runtime overlay or 'destroy is not a function' error. Add-transaction flow creates and persists a record. Logout clears session and /app redirects to /auth. Backend regression suite (test_securefin.py) passes 2/2; admin login + /api/auth/me, /dashboard, /transactions, /investments, /subscriptions, /budgets, /analytics, /security/events all return 200 with cookie session and 401 without.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is a single ~93 line but extremely long-line monolith (~40+ components inlined on one line each). Consider splitting into feature files (Overview, RecordsPage, SecurityCenter, Analytics, Auth) for maintainability and better React DevTools/debugging.
RecordsPage still uses `/* eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps */` on load effects — acceptable but a stable useCallback(load) referenced in deps would be cleaner and future-proof.
Global search fires an API call on every keystroke beyond length 1 without debounce (unlike the RecordsPage table search) — will spam /api/search.
seed_data_creation: Added one transaction 'T2 Coffee' 150 Food on admin account during UI test; created no other seed data. Prior TEST_ users from iteration_1 remain but are user-scoped and harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary user flows green as of iteration_2. Backend URL: money-vault-89.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend tests require REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var to be exported before pytest (see command in iteration_2). No open bugs.
rca of the issue: Original bug: RecordsPage had `useEffect(load, [type])` where `load` was an async arrow returning a Promise. React tried to call the Promise as a cleanup function on unmount → TypeError 'destroy is not a function' whenever the user navigated from a RecordsPage to another sidebar route, breaking all subsequent navigation. Fix (already applied in App.js line 79): wrap in `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [type])` so the effect returns undefined. Additionally, backend CORS_ORIGINS/FRONTEND_URL were updated to money-vault-89.preview.emergentagent.com so /api/dashboard and other endpoints no longer fail CORS. Verified end-to-end.
